title: Shift-site instruction
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, a register $r$, an exit label $e$, a map $m$ from the nine phases to labels, and a phase $j\in\{0,1,\ldots,8\}$, define the instruction as follows: phase $0$ tests whether the designated counter register is zero, going to $e$ if so and to phase $1$ otherwise; phase $1$ decrements that counter and goes to phase $2$. Phase $2$ tests whether $r$ is zero, going to phase $6$ if so and to phase $3$ otherwise; phase $3$ decrements $r$ and goes to phase $4$; phases $4$ and $5$ increment the designated register and go to phases $5$ and $2$, respectively. Phase $6$ tests whether the designated register is zero, going to phase $0$ if so and to phase $7$ otherwise; phase $7$ decrements it and goes to phase $8$; phase $8$ increments $r$ and goes to phase $6$.
hypotheses_covered: Map $m$ from nine phases to labels
caveat: The designated registers used in the instruction are referenced by names whose definitions are absent from the supplied context, so their mathematical roles cannot be stated precisely.
